title: The Iced Blue Christmas Tree Trimming Night
description: A family Christmas tree trimming night, all from Sam's Club: the Member's Mark 7 ft slim pre-lit tree, the Iced Over 80-count shatterproof ornament collection, a color changing tinsel garland, a galvanized tree collar, girls' pajamas and a holiday mug gift set.
intro: Tree night is the one night a year my kitchen looks like a glitter factory and I don't care. Slim tree in the corner, a galvanized collar so nobody has to see the ugly stand, a whole tray of icy blue and silver shatterproof ornaments (shatterproof, because small hands), a tinsel garland that changes colors, cozy pajamas for the littlest helper and mugs for the cocoa. Put on the music. Let the kids hang everything on one branch. Fix it after bedtime.

sections.heading: The tree
paragraphs: The Member's Mark 7 ft Slim Linden Fir pre-lit Christmas tree in the Member's Mark galvanized metal tree collar, 27 inches across.

sections.heading: The trimmings
paragraphs: The Member's Mark shatterproof ornament collection, 80 count, in the Iced Over blue and silver theme, and the Member's Mark 9 ft pre-lit color changing tinsel garland.

sections.heading: The cozy part
paragraphs: The Member's Mark DreamMark girls' 2-piece pajama set in purple and the holiday ceramic mug gift set, 4-pack.
